notes: Strain identities come from the title tokens. WT = DDB7, DDB16, DDB35, SDT122, SDT288 (titles '_WT' or DDB7 library-kit variants), labelled BW25113/K-12 from the design. _del_X = single-gene knockouts (strain_group K-12 assumed from the design's SGKO). DDB12 titles say del_qseB (7) and del_qseF (6) for the same ch:strain; labelled per title. Genotype left out for HMP3071 and SDT551 (tryptophan production strain / its empty-plasmid control, modifications not given), HMP3396, HMP3397, SDT107, SDT64 and the 'GenRed' strains (SDT158/162/211/212/237, meaning not given). ZnHigh -> metal_excess, ZnLow -> metal_limitation (relative to ZnCtrl; levels and timing not given, so no exposure). ZnFeHigh/ZnFeLow taken as the study's two base media ('High Metal'/'Low Metal'), treatment none. fast_feed/slow_feed and crash cultures: treatment none. DDB35 child_reactor: meaning unclear, treatment and is_control left out. Growth phase left out: batch samples have no OD or phase word, fed-batch is not a batch phase. Oxygen only for fed-batch (O2 supply stated). Temperature not given. inducer_added left out (production plasmids, induction not described). is_control: WT and BL21(DE3) samples without a Zn change true; deletions, HMP3427, HMP3071, SDT551 false; unknown-genotype strains left out. WT re-read: WT BW25113 strains (DDB7/16/35, SDT122/288) and BL21(DE3) with no plasmid stated -> wild_type.
